content:
There are reports on TV showing the smoke of the factory that rises up toward the moon.

Hmm, let me reconsider: "saxaar su weer yu bawoo ci usine bi" — "saxaar" = smoke, "su weer" = "black"? Actually "weer" in Wolof means "white"? "wekk"... "weex" is white, "ñuul" is black. "weer" means moon/month. So "saxaar su weer" = smoke that is bright/clear? "yu bawoo ci usine bi" = that come from the factory.

There are reports on TV showing moonlit/monthly smoke from the factory.

There are reports on TV showing smoke every month coming from the factory.
